purpose: Pre-registered ETTh1 H336 screen for a single-scan MambaTS v10 VAST-lite candidate.
research_question: Can a fixed channel order derived only from the training split's signed-ACF profiles close the ETTh1 H336 gap while retaining the direct AutoCon representation forecast path?
architecture: MambaTSv10 uses the existing v3 channel-major patch scan exactly once. A signed-ACF table is fitted from the training split only at fixed lags 24 and 48, then a deterministic greedy similarity path yields one channel permutation used in train and evaluation before output restoration. AutoCon's representation remains directly connected to a zero-initialized forecast residual. This is a VAST-lite local approximation, not a reproduction of the official MambaTS learned VPT/ATSP solver.
external_reference: Official MambaTS VPT/VAST implementation inspected at https://github.com/XiudingCai/MambaTS-pytorch; the public method learns an inference ordering from transition costs, whereas this preflight fixes a train-only ACF-derived ordering to preserve an auditable single-scan fast path.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory preflight. No test metric is produced, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A pass only licenses fresh-seed multi-dataset confirmation and matched prediction-only resource measurement. It does not license an official-MambaTS reproduction claim, a paper claim, or held-out test release.
prelaunch_gates: verify ETTh1 SHA256 and multivariate dimensions
verify MambaTSv10 direct AutoCon forecast connection
fit ACF from train split only and store its sidecar
retain exactly one Mamba scan and fixed evaluation order

phases.name: v10_autocon_null
phases.purpose: Exact MambaTSv10 graph and ACF-derived fixed order with AutoCon lambda zero.

phases.name: v10_autocon_active
phases.purpose: Exact MambaTSv10 graph and ACF-derived fixed order with AutoCon lambda 0.001.

primary_contrasts: v10 active versus exact v10 lambda-zero control
comparison_contract.resource_gate: After an accuracy pass, benchmark prediction-only v10 and PatchTST under the exact B32/L96/C7/H336 config with 50 warm-up and 200 timed GPU forwards.

stopping_rules: Do not change the ACF source, lags, ordering algorithm, lambda, seeds, or budget after launch.
Stop v10 before multi-dataset expansion if active mean validation MSE is higher than PatchTST or if active is not lower than its exact null in at least two of three seed pairs.
No test release, resource claim, or hyperparameter adjustment is allowed if either condition fails.
